tax.text: He said working families should get relief through lower taxation and a growing economy.
tax.quote: The answer to provide relief for working families is lower taxation through a growing economy.

debt.text: He said affordability should be addressed by reducing the debt and deficit.
debt.quote: We must also address affordability by reducing inflation through reductions in the debt and deficit.

immigration.text: He said he supports stopping illegal immigration, building the border wall and banning sanctuary cities.
immigration.quote: I 100% support President Trump’s approach to stopping illegal immigration. Illegal Immigration has been one of our country’s biggest problems and President Trump is the first president to address it seriously.

guns.text: He said no restrictions on gun ownership are needed and pledged to defend the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: None. I'm 100% pro 2nd Amendment. I have a track record of defending the 2nd Amendment as a Wyoming legislator and will continue protecting the 2nd amendment.

abortion.text: He described himself as fully pro-life and said he would continue that position in Congress.
abortion.quote: I have a 100% pro-life track record and will continue that in Congress.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He agreed that biological males should not participate in women’s sports or occupy women’s spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: He called for more private-market competition and interstate insurance sales, while criticizing the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: We need to roll back regulations that allow for competition that will bring down prices and allow for insurance to be sold across state lines, which the ACA has discouraged.

energy.text: He said coal, oil, and gas should supply growing electricity demand and called for ending wind subsidies.
energy.quote: Coal and oil and gas. Woke wind is wrong for Wyoming, and I have worked to STOP wind projects in our state. We must END all subsidies for wind.

voting.text: He backed voter ID and proof-of-citizenship requirements and said he would pursue similar election rules federally.
voting.quote: As a state legislator, I was the lead sponsor of Wyoming's voter ID, which passed in 2021. As the Wyoming Secretary of State, I led the effort to pass proof of citizenship for registering to vote.

tax.text: She supports taxing wealthy people to improve services while lowering taxes for people earning under $100,000.
tax.quote: Taxing the wealthy is another way to improve services to everyone while lowering taxes for those making less than $100,000.

wages.text: She said she would support raising the minimum wage.
wages.quote: I would work to remove tariffs, would promote universal healthcare and raise the minimum wage.

trade.text: She supports removing tariffs and increasing international trade to lower costs.
trade.quote: I feel that removing tariffs and increasing international trade will be the first step to lowering the cost of living for our citizens.

schools.text: She supports public education and calls for restoring the Department of Education.
schools.quote: Support the freedom of thought provided by public education, public libraries, public radio and television. Re-establish the Department of Education

immigration.text: She supports a more accessible path to citizenship and allowing non-citizens to remain while pursuing legal status.
immigration.quote: We need a reasonable and easier path to citizenship by hiring more immigration judges and staff, allowing non-citizens to live here while they pursue a legal pathway to stay in our country.

abortion.text: She described herself as personally pro-life but said she is pro-choice for others.
abortion.quote: she said she’s “pro-life for me,” but “pro-choice for everyone else.”

health.text: She supports universal health care, restoring ACA subsidies, and expanding Medicaid eligibility.
health.quote: We should bring back the ACA subsidies as a start, and raise the income guidelines for Medicaid by expanding it, too.

voting.text: She supports reaffirming the Voting Rights Act as part of strengthening constitutional rights.
voting.quote: I want to strengthen our rights under the Constitution by reaffirming the Voting Rights Act, putting some teeth in Civil Rights laws, getting rid of all violent ICE activities, honoring equal rights laws

tax.text: He said he would support reducing unnecessary federal taxes and spending to lower costs for Wyoming families.
tax.quote: I would support legislation that puts more money back in the pockets of Wyoming families by reducing federal spending, unnecessary taxes, and regulations that drive up the cost of living.

debt.text: He favors reducing federal spending while also protecting Social Security benefits already earned and changing how younger workers may direct some payroll taxes.
debt.quote: I would also reform Social Security by protecting benefits already earned while giving younger workers the choice to direct a portion of their payroll taxes into individually owned, state-sponsored retirement accounts they can invest and pass on.

immigration.text: He supports border security and enforcement alongside faster legal pathways for workers and prompt processing of legitimate asylum claims.
immigration.quote: I would secure the border, enforce the laws already on the books, and fix the broken legal immigration system. Wyoming needs workers in agriculture, ranching, energy, construction, and other industries, but our immigration system should not force employers or families to navigate years of unnecessary bureaucracy. I would support faster legal pathways for workers our economy needs, while ensuring employers follow the law and American workers are protected.

health.text: He opposes the Affordable Care Act and favors more insurance competition, cross-state plan sales, and price transparency.
health.quote: To address health care costs, we need to incentivize competition and to allow insurance to be sold across state lines. This competition will bring down prices.

energy.text: He said he would expand responsible energy development and remove barriers that he believes increase energy costs.
energy.quote: Wyoming produces the energy that powers America, yet our families still face high costs for fuel, electricity, food, and housing. I would expand responsible energy development and remove unnecessary barriers that increase costs.

debt.text: He said Social Security benefits should be gradually reduced to return the program to its original purpose.
debt.quote: With more people living longer it puts a strain on the system. We need to cut back on the bleed by slowly eliminating some of the benefits and get back to what it was originally meant to do, provide retired workers age 65 or older a means to care for themselves.

safety.text: He agreed that mandatory minimum sentences should be required and enforced for violent crimes.
safety.quote: Mandatory minimum sentencing should be required and enforced for violent crimes.

immigration.text: He supports a border wall and infrastructure to give the United States complete control over entry and exit.
immigration.quote: I am in favor of construction of a wall and other necessary infrastructure on our border that gives complete control over entering and exiting the United States.

guns.text: He opposes gun registration and would prohibit gun ownership for people convicted of violent felonies.
guns.quote: If you are a felon convicted of a violent crime - no gun. I do not believe in gun registration.

abortion.text: He said he opposes abortion, with an exception when continuing the pregnancy would likely cause the mother's death.
abortion.quote: I am against abortion, but if it comes down to the mother, or the baby, I think the mother should get first choice.

health.text: He opposes eliminating private health insurance and said he does not support a government-run, single-payer system.
health.quote: I support the elimination of private healthcare insurance. Strongly Disagree
